  const startMark = "consent-banner-load-start";
  const endMarkSuccess = "consent-banner-load-success";
  const endMarkError = "consent-banner-load-error";
  const measureName = "consent-banner-load-duration";

  performance.mark(startMark);
  import(consentBannerUrl)
    .then((module) => {
      performance.mark(endMarkSuccess);
      window.ekGdprConsentBanner = module;

      // TODO: advertising: move to Liberty.js
      window.adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || {};

      window.googletag = window.googletag || {};
      window.googletag.cmd = window.googletag.cmd || [];

      window.pbjs = window.pbjs || {};

      window.ekGdprConsentBanner.setPrebidUserSyncOnConsentChange(window.pbjs);
    })
    .catch((error) => {
      performance.mark(endMarkError);
      if (error instanceof Error) {
        const blockerCount = window.advertisingNoBlockerCount;
        const adBlockerDetected =
          typeof blockerCount === "number" && blockerCount !== 4;
        const message = `Error dynamically importing consent banner: ${error.message}`;

        const enhancedError = new Error(message);
        enhancedError.cause = error;
        enhancedError.blockerCount = blockerCount;
        enhancedError.adBlockerDetected = adBlockerDetected;
        throw enhancedError;
      }
      throw error;
    })
    .finally(() => {
      try {
        // Measure successful load
        performance.measure(measureName, startMark, endMarkSuccess);
      } catch {
        try {
          // Measure failed load
          performance.measure(measureName, startMark, endMarkError);
        } catch {
          // Errors during measurement are less critical, but could be reported to an error tracking service
        }
      }
      // Clean up marks
      performance.clearMarks(startMark);
      performance.clearMarks(endMarkSuccess);
      performance.clearMarks(endMarkError);
      performance.clearMeasures(measureName);
    });

  async function processFields(refineForm) {
    const intFields = refineForm.querySelectorAll(
      '.j-fld-type-INT, [data-attribute-type="INT"]',
    );
    intFields.forEach((field) => {
      if (field.value) {
        let keyField = field.nextElementSibling;
        if (
          !keyField ||
          !keyField.hasAttribute("data-role") ||
          keyField.getAttribute("data-role") !== "suggestion-key"
        ) {
          keyField = refineForm.querySelector(
            `[data-role="suggestion-key"][name="${field.name}Key"]`,
          );
        }

        if (keyField) {
          let realVal = keyField.value || field.value;
          realVal = realVal.replace(/\./g, "");

          if (isNaN(parseInt(realVal, 10))) {
            field.value = "";
            keyField.value = "";
          } else {
            keyField.value = parseInt(realVal, 10);
          }
        }
      }
    });

    function unlocalizeDecimal(value) {
      return value.replace(",", ".");
    }

    const decimalFields = refineForm.querySelectorAll(
      '.j-fld-type-DECIMAL, [data-attribute-type="DECIMAL"]',
    );
    decimalFields.forEach((field) => {
      if (field.value) {
        let keyField = field.nextElementSibling;
        if (
          !keyField ||
          !keyField.hasAttribute("data-role") ||
          keyField.getAttribute("data-role") !== "suggestion-key"
        ) {
          keyField = refineForm.querySelector(
            `[data-role="suggestion-key"][name="${field.name}Key"]`,
          );
        }

        if (keyField) {
          const realVal = unlocalizeDecimal(keyField.value || field.value);

          if (isNaN(parseFloat(realVal))) {
            field.value = "";
            keyField.value = "";
          } else {
            keyField.value = unlocalizeDecimal(realVal);
          }
        }
      }
    });

    if (dominantCategoryId) {
      let useSuggestedCategory = false;
      const attributeInputs = refineForm.querySelectorAll(
        '[data-browsebox-attribute] input[type="hidden"]',
      );

      attributeInputs.forEach((input) => {
        if (input.name.match(/^attributeMap.*/) && input.value) {
          useSuggestedCategory = true;
        }
      });

      if (useSuggestedCategory) {
        const searchCategoryIdField = document.getElementById(
          "browsebox-field-categoryid",
        );
        if (searchCategoryIdField) {
          searchCategoryIdField.value = dominantCategoryId.toString();
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function attachBrowseBoxSubmitHandler(formId, processFields) {
    const form = document.getElementById(formId);
    if (!form) return;

    form.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      await processFields(form);
      form.submit();
    });
  }

  attachBrowseBoxSubmitHandler("browsebox-form", processFields);
})();</script></div></div><div class="sticky top-small"><div aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" data-liberty-position-name="srpb-sky-btf-left" class="min-h-[600px] flex flex-col justify-center   const unCropImages = {
    init: function () {
      function onLoad(image) {
        if (image.naturalHeight > image.naturalWidth) {
          const imageContainer = image.closest("[data-image-container]");

          if (imageContainer) {
            image.classList.remove("object-cover");
            image.classList.add("object-contain", "z-[3]");

            const adItemImageAnchor = imageContainer.closest("a");

            if (adItemImageAnchor) {
              adItemImageAnchor.classList.add(
                "relative",
                "overflow-hidden",
                "rounded",
                "block",
              );

              const background = document.createElement("div");
              background.classList.add(
                "bg-no-repeat",
                "bg-cover",
                "absolute",
                "top-none",
                "left-none",
                "z-[2]",
                "w-[105%]",
                "h-[105%]",
                "opacity-[0.4]",
                "blur-[12px]",
                "transform-gpu",
              );
              background.style.backgroundImage = `url(${image.src})`;
              adItemImageAnchor.appendChild(background);
            }
          }
        }
      }

      const images = document.querySelectorAll("[data-image-container] img");

      for (const image of images) {
        if (image.loading === "lazy") {
          image.addEventListener("load", () => onLoad(image));
        } else {
          onLoad(image);
        }
      }
    },
  };

  if (isFashionAndBeautyCategory()) {
    unCropImages.init();
  }
